semantic_meaning: Marks the exact leverage pivot/control surface where the system can be steered.
when_to_use: When introducing the chokepoint/control surface in a system diagram
When shifting from broad map to actionable lever
When restating 'where the leverage is' before a key claim
when_not_to_use: To highlight routine nouns or section headers
When no control surface is being claimed

forbidden.red: Do not use red unless showing consequence/failure/exposure.
forbidden.amber_decorative: Amber cannot be used as general accent.

animation_behavior.description: Pivot marker pulses once, locks, then hands off to downstream motion (route trace / map reframe).

input_parameters.name: pivot_position
input_parameters.description: x/y position of the pivot in the diagram coordinate space.

input_parameters.name: label
input_parameters.description: Optional short label (<= 18 chars) shown near the pivot.

state_beats.label: pivot_pulse
state_beats.meaningful_change: Single pulse/scan confirms 'this is the lever'.

state_beats.label: pivot_lock
state_beats.meaningful_change: Marker locks; camera/diagram reframes to pivot context.

expected_outputs: A clearly identifiable amber pivot marker at the leverage point
Timeline beats that can be validated for motion cadence
validation_notes: Amber must only appear when a control surface is being asserted.
No beat may hold longer than 4 seconds without a state change.

hyperframes.notes: Pair with `route-trace` to show flow to/from the pivot.
